purpose: Test whether preserving the exact same-seed native Random command-prefix cohort and changing only the node assignment of those emitted players can improve concurrent burst throughput and QPR without increasing placement count or consulting outcomes.

technical_diagnosis.observed_failure: The unchanged Random baseline returns from the entire scheduling window when it first encounters an unscheduled function with no placement candidate. It can therefore emit a strict command prefix even though later functions remain in the common-HPA feasible All frontier.
technical_diagnosis.v141_contract_conflict: V141 required the exact native Random command sequence, no baseline modification, and a complete assignment of the full feasible All frontier. The observed state proves those three requirements cannot hold simultaneously.
technical_diagnosis.v142_repair_axis: Define the treatment cohort as exactly the ordered request-function players for which the unchanged Random baseline emitted ScheCmd messages before its native early stop. Preserve that cohort and command count exactly; compare alternative node assignments only for those players.
non_repairs: do not change Random, common HPA, candidate filtering, workload, SLA, FaaSRank model, cost, paper equations, or offline reference policy
do not fill, defer differently, or otherwise schedule any feasible player outside the exact Random command-prefix cohort in that window
do not tune thresholds, weights, scenario branches, seeds, or routes from V140 or V141 outcomes
do not reuse E1523-E1525 or open confirmation seeds E1497-E1516
do not delete, relabel, or selectively rerun V141 artifacts

hypotheses.primary: Holding the per-window placement cohort and count equal to the unchanged Random baseline removes workload-intensity confounding while allowing a current-state node reassignment to improve completions.
hypotheses.secondary: A threshold-free service or welfare Pareto selector over assignments projected onto the exact Random cohort can reject harmful native alternatives and retain Random unchanged when no admissible replacement exists.
hypotheses.falsification: The family is falsified if none of the three treatments passes all nine strict scenario-by-metric gates on the complete E1526-E1528 cohort.

allowed: exact current simulator state, common-HPA candidates, containers, queues, node resources, configured bandwidth, and immutable function and DAG configuration
the exact persistent same-seed native Random command stream, including its unchanged early-stop behavior
Greedy, Hiku, Jiagu, Orion, and LoadLeast assignments captured on private channels and projected only onto the Random-emitted player cohort
current admitted immutable work, same-window projected immutable work, cold start, configured parent transfer, and immutable-baseline paper welfare
forbidden: completion, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, or any completed-request aggregate
future state, scenario or burst label, seed identity, registered burst intervals, V140 or V141 performance values, fitted coefficients, learned thresholds, or outcome feedback
any player not emitted by Random in the current window
confirmation seeds E1497-E1516 before a V142 training pass
information_boundary.fail_closed: Any RNG-seed mismatch, Random command mismatch, projected-cohort mismatch, incomplete or infeasible projected assignment, unavailable or nonfinite certificate, provenance mismatch, or failed blind audit rejects reveal; unavailable replacement evidence dispatches the exact Random prefix unchanged.

random_prefix_contract.implementation: RandomScheduler remains byte-for-byte behaviorally unchanged. One persistent shadow uses the identical algorithm-seed constructor, request/function/candidate iteration, RNG advancement, and early-stop semantics as standalone Random.
random_prefix_contract.lifecycle: Initialize once per run and invoke exactly once per scheduling window, including empty windows.
random_prefix_contract.cohort: The ordered cohort is exactly the unique request-function players present in Random ScheCmd messages. It may be a strict subset of the common feasible All frontier and may be empty.
random_prefix_contract.projection: Every non-Random native candidate is evaluated only after projecting its complete assignment onto the Random cohort. Missing, extra-dispatched, duplicate, infeasible, or reordered cohort players fail closed.
random_prefix_contract.dispatch: Every V142 arm emits exactly one command per Random-cohort player and emits no command for any other player. Exact-anchor fallback preserves Random command order and node IDs.
random_prefix_contract.regression: A paired multi-window fixture with an infeasible task before later feasible tasks must prove standalone Random and the shadow have bit-identical early-stop command order, assignment hash, cohort, and RNG continuation across later windows before inputs are generated.

treatments.nash_acceptance: same cohort and command count; complete proposal; service maximum nonworse; service sum strictly lower; paper welfare nonworse

treatments.initializer: Random default; replace only by a projected native assignment with service maximum nonworse, service sum strictly lower, and paper welfare nonworse; choose minimum service sum, then maximum welfare, then stable native kind
treatments.nash_acceptance: same frozen guard relative to the selected same-cohort initializer

treatments.initializer: Random default; replace only by a projected native assignment with service maximum nonworse, service sum nonworse, and paper welfare strictly higher; choose maximum welfare, then minimum service sum, then stable native kind
treatments.nash_acceptance: same frozen guard relative to the selected same-cohort initializer

native_portfolio.numeric_rule: Only the existing 1e-6 machine comparison; no fitted tolerance or scenario branch.

training_design.independent_unit: one newly captured workload tape and environment seed
training_design.blocks: scenario-by-seed; all nine baselines and all three treatments share tape, environment, HPA, SLA, model, binary, and reference state
training_design.run_order_rule: Within each scenario-by-seed block use one seeded permutation of all twelve methods; never reorder after any result or failure.

selection_rule.per_candidate_per_scenario_per_metric: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the maximum concurrent baseline mean and candidate-minus-each-baseline is strictly positive on at least two of three paired seeds
selection_rule.family_pass: at least one preregistered candidate passes
selection_rule.multiple_passing_candidates: largest minimum relative mean margin across all nine gates; exact ties by ascending arm_id
selection_rule.zero_completion: retain every run; finite-only QPR is unavailable and zero-completed-as-zero is zero; no imputation or seed replacement
selection_rule.confirmation: Training authorizes no paper or operational claim. Only a selected treatment may trigger a separately preregistered untouched confirmation cohort.

logging_and_blind_audit.per_window: log Random RNG identity/lifecycle/early-stop position, exact command-prefix hashes and player cohort, full feasible count, every projected native assignment/hash/certificate, selected kind/reason, exact dispatch count/cohort equality, Nash guard evidence, and existing solver/reference observations
logging_and_blind_audit.blind_audit: Before reveal validate exact 108-run product, attempt-1 QC, zero quarantine, ledgers, runtime consensus, pairings, 12 fresh tapes, 27 references, exact Random lifecycle and early-stop trace, exact command-count/cohort equality, projected native selection, state-domain equality, and zero parsed performance summaries.
